source_references.usage: Source of truth for final DER, false alarm, miss, confusion, and speaker-count scoring. Original mlx2 preflight scorer is cross-checked against these scores; no NeMo code copied.
Evaluation protocol: zero-second collar, overlap included, manifest-linked RTTM labels and per-profile streaming settings.

modifications: Selective port of the original corpus preflight scorer, pinned Transformers MPS candidate harness, independent NeMo scoring finalizer with explicit hypothesis manifests, source-bound per-profile CLI receipt gate, request-isolation probe, and focused runbook. The v3 plan calibrates separate per-recording bounds for the model's eight-speaker capacity stratum. The existing adapter is unchanged.
validation: Historical branch: 248-recording CPU preflight, lifecycle probe, full 248-recording v3 offline GPU candidate, pinned independent NeMo score on both corpora, observed qualified CLI on AMI, and changed-threshold/unqualified-profile negative controls. Current-main port: exact adapter and weight SHA-256 verification, actual offline receipt admission plus negative settings/source controls, focused CPU tests, and lint. Full low/very_low/ultra_low corpus runs are separate and not yet qualified.
